name: Bucharest Cubing B 2023

venue.name: [Universitatea Romano Americana](https://www.rau.ro/)
venue.details: Three classrooms at the first floor. Follow the signs.

information:
At the registration you can support the association "Asociatia Romana de Speedcubing" with a contribution and you will get a cubing prize. More details on http://www.speedcubing.ro
**This is a series competition, if you compete in Bucharest Cubing A you can't compete in Bucharest Cubing B.
Please specify in the comment box in which day you want to participate. You can participate only in one day.
